name: Can I live in my home during a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: Can I live in my home during a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can live in your home during a kitchen remodel depends on the extent of the project. For minor remodels, it's often feasible, though you'll experience some disruption and will be without a fully functional kitchen. For major renovations involving significant demolition, dust, noise, and utility shut-offs, many clients choose to make alternative living arrangements. We work to minimize inconvenience and keep you informed of the project's impact.
acceptedAnswer.description: Living at home during a kitchen remodel depends on project scope; minor remodels are feasible, but major ones may require temporary relocation.
